source='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    clockwise = [[grid[n - 1 - j][i] for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]
    counterclockwise = [[grid[j][n - 1 - i] for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]
    halfturn = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    output = []
    for i in range(n):
        output.append(list(grid[i]) + clockwise[i])
    for i in range(n):
        output.append(counterclockwise[i] + halfturn[i])
    return output
'''
